title: Global context, project context and deeper agent knowledge
situations: Agent starts outside any Yoke project
Agent starts in a configured project
Work needs a new skill, schema or project fact
A main agent delegates or resumes after compaction
current: Research trace; requirements and source paths need live proof. Outside-project global hook orientation, user-level yoke-global appearance and actual global receiving proof remain pending under YOK-3975; project-installed source cannot prove them.
questions: Does every action-bearing role get the right context with no source-checkout assumptions?
What survives compaction or handoff, and what must be read again?
Are instruction, schema, live-state and evidence authorities clearly separated?
Trace SESSION.md and other harness-native continuity files by actual loading/ownership, without assuming a universal file exists.
Do not treat UI preferences as a general agent-memory store. JOURNEYS reminder suppression remains an open design question.
